note: vrc is required — a delivery with no credential delivers nothing.
vrcDigestMultibase is the framework's DigestMultibase — multibase-multihash, not a bare hex digest that hard-codes one algorithm into the wire contract.
The base58btc alphabet is enforced, not assumed: 0, O, I and l are excluded, so a z-prefixed value is not automatically conforming.
Unknown top-level member is rejected; ecosystem data belongs under `ext` (SPEC.md §4.5.1).
